Boiler service notes: Engineer: Farid from Northgate Heating, came on 21 October.
The boiler is a Calderline 28 combi, fitted in 2017.
He cleaned the condensate trap and replaced the seal on the flue.
Pressure was low at 0.6 bar; he topped it up to 1.2 bar.
He said the pump makes a noise at start-up and may need replacing within two years. A new pump costs about £280 fitted.
Next service due: October next year. Book in August, because the autumn fills up fast.
